name: Christmas Lite Show Drive-Thru
address: 4500 W. River Dr. NE, Comstock Park, MI 49321
when_note: Nightly November 25, 2026 through January 2, 2027; 5:30 to 9 PM Monday to Thursday and 5:30 to 10 PM Friday to Sunday
cost: $30 online or $35 at the gate per family vehicle; the Memory Lane Train is $40 per bench
paras: The Christmas Lite Show turns LMCU Ballpark in Comstock Park into a two-mile drive-through Christmas light display from November 25, 2026 through January 2, 2027. It is open from 5:30 to 9 PM Monday through Thursday and 5:30 to 10 PM Friday through Sunday.

Families ride through animated displays and lighted tunnels in their own car or aboard the Memory Lane Train. Admission is charged per vehicle and covers everyone inside: $30 online or $35 at the gate for a family vehicle. The Memory Lane Train is $40 per bench.
tip: Buy online to save $5 per family vehicle.

name: Breakfast with Santa at Dave & Buster's Kentwood
cost: $22 for the Holly Jolly Breakfast (food only); $25.99 for Santa's Ultimate Workshop (food and play)
paras: Dave & Buster's in Kentwood hosts Breakfast with Santa on Sunday, December 6, 2026, from 9 to 11 AM at 3660 28th St. SE.
Families choose between the Holly Jolly Breakfast for $22, which is food only, and Santa's Ultimate Workshop for $25.99, which adds play. Tickets are sold in advance.
tip: Pick the Ultimate Workshop ticket if the kids want arcade play.

name: The Santa Cabin at Bosch's Countryview Nursery
venue: Bosch's Choose and Cut Tree Farm
when_note: Friday, November 27, Saturday, November 28 and Saturday, December 5, 2026, 10 AM to 4 PM
paras: At Bosch's Choose and Cut Tree Farm in Allendale, families ride a horse-drawn wagon through the woods to Santa's log cabin. The Santa Cabin runs Friday, November 27, Saturday, November 28 and Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 10 AM to 4 PM.

Each $12 ticket includes the wagon ride, a visit inside the cabin with Santa, a s'mores package and time around the campfire toasting marshmallows. A hot chocolate comes with tickets bought at the refreshment checkout.
tip: Dress for the cold since the wagon ride and campfire are outside.

name: Magic at the Mill at Windmill Island Gardens
when_note: Friday and Saturday evenings December 4, 5, 11, 12, 18 and 19, 2026, 5 to 9 PM; Sinterklaas greets kids 5:30 to 8:30 PM
cost: $10 for adults 16 and up; $5 for ages 3 to 15; free for children 2 and under
paras: Magic at the Mill lights up Windmill Island Gardens in Holland on Friday and Saturday evenings December 4 through 19, 2026, from 5 to 9 PM.

Children can greet Sinterklaas, the Dutch predecessor of Santa Claus, from 5:30 to 8:30 PM each evening. Snacks and drinks are sold on site. Tickets are $10 for adults 16 and up and $5 for ages 3 to 15, and children 2 and under are free. Tickets must be bought in advance online.
tip: Buy tickets early because they sell out.

name: Pictures with Santa at The Tina Peterson Team Office
address: 4959 W. Grand River Ave., Howell, MI 48855
paras: The Tina Peterson Team hosts free Pictures with Santa on Saturday, December 5, 2026, from 12 to 4 PM at 4959 W. Grand River Ave. in Howell.

Families get professional photos with Santa, hear Santa sing Christmas carols, and enjoy face painting, a hot chocolate and cookies bar, a letter-writing station for Santa letters and a coloring corner.
tip: Bring the kids' letters to Santa or write them at the station.
